spans.text: 【Warning】 The following is an important hint for this battle, please do not skip it!
As you can see, these are our neural cloud servers.
They may look heavy and bulky, but they're actually really fragile.
If you fight near them, there's a very high chance that you'll damage the hardware, which leads to data loss and damage.
The neural cloud servers contain the precious memories of the Dolls, so please carefully consider their position in battle.
